expectation: Commands expose usage and flags through --help.
example_feedback: Run `gh flarebyte repo update --help` to see the update flags.

expectation: An existing local configuration is rejected unless --overwrite is supplied.
example_feedback: `.gh-flarebyte.cue already exists in /path/to/repo. Re-run with --overwrite if replacing it is intentional`

expectation: Config load failures report the resolved file path and filesystem error. --repo does not replace the requirement for local configuration.
example_feedback: `cannot read config /path/to/repo/.gh-flarebyte.cue: open /path/to/repo/.gh-flarebyte.cue: no such file or directory`

expectation: Validation identifies an invalid field or field combination.
example_feedback: `invalid build.targets entry "linux/x64": expected os-arch format such as linux-amd64 or windows-amd64`

expectation: Topic/label deletions without --confirm-deletions are rejected with counts and the required flag.
example_feedback: `update would delete 2 labels and 1 topics. Re-run with --confirm-deletions if that is intentional`

expectation: Visibility changes without acknowledgement are rejected with old/new values and the required flag.
example_feedback: `visibility would change from public to private. Re-run with --accept-visibility-change-consequences if that is intentional`

expectation: Build errors report the failing tool or mode. Go target failures also print the effective environment and build command.
example_feedback: `Build failed in library mode during dart pub/analyze/test.`

expectation: Release returns build failures before publishing; later errors report version/tag or GitHub publication failure.
example_feedback: `release tag v1.2.3 already exists. refusing to mutate existing release implicitly`

expectation: Updates stop on remote failure without rollback; later-stage errors include recorded settings/topic progress and the cause.
example_feedback: `Update stopped after repository settings and topics were applied. Label sync failed, and no rollback was attempted. Fix the error and rerun gh flarebyte repo update. Cause: API error`

expectation: Audit reports differences and points to repo update; a clean audit reports no drift.
example_feedback: `3 differences found. Review the drift report below, then run gh flarebyte repo update when ready to apply changes.`
